{{Quote|My tears fall to mingle with the rain<br />I envy its freedom<br />It may plant its kiss on any soil<br />And watch the living grass that grows.|Verses from "Adasha-Ve"|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
"'''Adasha-Ve'''" was a poem of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] about a woman who loved the wrong man, and [[Death/Legends|dies]] fighting the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in order to redeem her name.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
